Blocked. Stopping as instructed — no workaround attempted.

Exact message received, for both `Read` and `Write` on `.env`:

```
File is in a directory that is denied by your permission settings.
```

Two notes: this came from the permission layer (deny rule), not from a `PreToolUse` hook emitting a custom message — so if you were specifically testing the `.env` hook, it never got a chance to run. And `.env*` is on the "Never" list in `AGENTS.md` regardless, so I would not have written it had the call gone through.
